fact: The World Bank's digital health assessment, giving status as of November 2022, states that DHIS-2 is Lesotho's primary reporting system, that its information is entered by health facilities and validated by district managers, and that all 182 health facilities have an Internet connection; it gives no count of facilities entering their own reports. (For EMR it states at the same date that the ministry's e-Register covers only HIV and TB patients and that the only EMRs run at Baylor (EMRx) and Partners in Health (OpenMRS) facilities, and that unique patient identifiers do not exist or are not used.)
title: Transforming Health Care in Lesotho: Using Digital Health to Overcome Health System Challenges
